description: Land Acquisition - Deraniyagala, Deraniyagala D/S Division, Kegalle District
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains a declaration that specific parcels of land are needed for public purpose and will be acquired, including detailed descriptions of the land lots, their boundaries, and extents. While it mentions a minister's name and title, the core content focuses entirely on land matters rather than government personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities, making it a Land Gazette (Type 4).
